      • childByName

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nullable
public static com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable childByName(@Nonnull
                                                                                                                 com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIARObject self,
                                                                                                                 @Nonnull
                                                                                                                 java.lang.String relativePath)
        The childByName(MIARObject, String) method returns the child MIReferrable below the specified object which has this relative AUTOSAR path (not starting with '/'). 
         
 MIContainer canGeneral = ...
 MIContainer mainFunctionRWPeriods
   = canGeneral.childByName("CanMainFunctionRWPeriods")

        Remark: Even in post-build selectable models this method expects to find at most one object because script code will never run in an unfiltered context.

        Parameters:
        self -
        relativePath -
        Returns:
        the found object or null if not found

      • childByName

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nullable
public static com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable childByName(@Nonnull
                                                                                                                 com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIARObject self,
                                                                                                                 @Nonnull
                                                                                                                 java.lang.String relativePath,
                                                                                                                 @VClassClosureParams(value=com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable.class)
                                                                                                                 groovy.lang.Closure<?> code)
        The childByName(MIARObject, String, Closure) method calls the passed Closure, if the request child exists. And returns the child MIReferrable below the specified object which has this relative AUTOSAR path (not starting with '/'). 
         
 MIContainer canGeneral = ...
 canGeneral.childByName("CanMainFunctionRWPeriods"){ child->
      //Do something
 }

        Remark: Even in post-build selectable models this method expects to find at most one object because script code will never run in an unfiltered context.

        Parameters:
        self -
        relativePath -
        code - code to execute if the child exists.
        Returns:
        the found object or null if not found

      • getReferencesPointingToMe

        @PublishedMethod
public static java.util.List<com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIReferenceValue> getReferencesPointingToMe(com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable self)
        The getReferencesPointingToMe() method returns all reference parameters in the active ecuc pointing to specified target (MIReferrable) object. It returns an empty collection if the target object is invisible or removed.

        The returned parameters are sorted by means of IReferenceAccess.sortReferences(Collection).

        Remark: This method doesn't return objects contained in the DerivedEcuC!

        If you need other reference resolution API please use the IReferenceAccess.

        Parameters:
        self - is the object, the searched reference parameters point to
        Returns:
        the list of MIReferenceValues active ecuc elements pointing to self
        See Also:
        IReferenceAccess

      • getReferencesPointingToMe

        @PublishedMethod
public static java.util.List<com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIReferenceValue> getReferencesPointingToMe(com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable self,
                                                                                                                                                  DefRef defRef)
        The getReferencesPointingToMe(DefRef) method returns all reference parameters in the active ecuc with the specified definition (DefRef) pointing to the specified target (MIReferrable) object. It returns an empty collection if the target object is invisible, removed or the specified definition is null.

        The returned parameters are sorted by means of IReferenceAccess.sortReferences(Collection).

        Remark: This method doesn't return derived objects (located in the InitialEcuC)!

        If you need other reference resolution API please use the IReferenceAccess.

        Parameters:
        self - is the object, the searched reference parameters point to
        defRef - is a parameter DefRef
        Returns:
        the list of MIReferenceValues active ecuc elements pointing to self
        See Also:
        IReferenceAccess

      • getSystemDescriptionObjectsPointingToMe

        @PublishedMethod
public static java.util.List<MIObject> getSystemDescriptionObjectsPointingToMe(com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable self)
        The method getSystemDescriptionObjectsPointingToMe() returns all objects located in the system description which are parent objects of references pointing to the specified target. It returns an empty collection if the object is invisible or removed.

        The returned parameters are sorted by means of IReferenceAccess.sortReferences(Collection).

        If you need other reference resolution API please use the IReferenceAccess.

        Parameters:
        self - is the object, the searched reference parameters point to
        Returns:
        the list of MIObjects of system description elements pointing to self
        See Also:
        IReferenceAccess
